# Business Rules Model

The Business Rules Model says which policies and invariants govern the work. Each rule cites the goal it serves (`serves`) and may trigger a process.

Method: 4EM (Sandkuhl, Stirna, Persson and Wißotzki, *Enterprise Modeling: Tackling Business Challenges with the 4EM Method*, Springer 2014). Every element cites its source; `decided` means a source shows that the operator decided it.

| <a id="rule-flow-layout-by-app"></a><code>rule-flow-layout-by-app</code><br/>Business rule | **The application owns node layout.** Node positions come from the application, which owns the graph. The library imports no layout engine. | decided | serves: [A generic library with no product logic](goals.md#goal-flow-generic-library); constrains: [packages/flow (the library)](technical-components.md#comp-flow-library) | [log L109][141], [log L111][153], [foldkit-flow:README.md:7][152], [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:31][149], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/types.ts:42-59][154], [foldkit-flow:apps/example/src/graphs.ts:4-5][155] |
| <a id="rule-flow-attribution-default"></a><code>rule-flow-attribution-default</code><br/>Business rule | **Credit xyflow by default.** The "Built with xyflow" link is visible by default. It hides only when the application sets Attribution to Hidden. **If** The application does not set the attribution option. **Then** Show the link in the corner of the canvas. | decided | serves: [Credit and respect xyflow](goals.md#goal-flow-respect-xyflow); constrains: [Attribution option and view](technical-components.md#comp-flow-attribution) | [log L106][156], [foldkit-flow:README.md:86][157], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:53][158], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:69][148] |
| <a id="rule-flow-spec-code-pr"></a><code>rule-flow-spec-code-pr</code><br/>Business rule | **One spec, one branch, one PR.** Each change has one spec in docs/specs, one branch named feat/NNNN-slug and one PR. A spec that needs two PRs was two specs. | decided | serves: [Every change travels spec, code, PR](goals.md#goal-flow-lifecycle); triggers: [Ship a spec as a PR](business-processes.md#process-flow-ship-spec) | [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:13-15][159], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-pr-after-ready"></a><code>rule-flow-pr-after-ready</code><br/>Business rule | **Open the PR only after the journey is built.** A PR opens only when the whole journey is built and `bun run ready` passed on the head. The PR freezes the spec. | decided | serves: [Every change travels spec, code, PR](goals.md#goal-flow-lifecycle) | [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:15][160], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-main-protected"></a><code>rule-flow-main-protected</code><br/>Business rule | **Main takes PRs that pass checks.** Main requires a pull request, even from administrators, and a passing `checks` status. No force push and no branch deletion. | decided | serves: [Every change travels spec, code, PR](goals.md#goal-flow-lifecycle); constrains: [The project's own repository](actors-and-resources.md#resource-flow-repo) | [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:19][161], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:56][162], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-exceptions-registered"></a><code>rule-flow-exceptions-registered</code><br/>Business rule | **Every lint suppression has a registry entry.** A suppression directive needs an entry in the exception registry, and an entry needs a live suppression. The check fails otherwise. **If** A file contains a suppression directive such as oxlint-disable. **Then** Require a registry entry with a reason and a retirement trigger. | decided | serves: [Every change travels spec, code, PR](goals.md#goal-flow-lifecycle); constrains: [tools/quality (repository checks)](technical-components.md#comp-flow-quality-tools) | [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:44][163], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:45][164], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-effect-range-by-stability"></a><code>rule-flow-effect-range-by-stability</code><br/>Business rule | **A package accepts only the Effect versions it can trust.** A package that uses an unstable or experimental Effect API accepts nothing above the next minor. **If** A package under packages/ uses an unstable or experimental Effect API. **Then** Cap its Effect range at the next minor, for example `~4.1.0`. | decided | serves: [Stay on supported Effect APIs and fix problems upstream](goals.md#goal-org-stay-on-supported-stack); constrains: [packages/flow (the library)](technical-components.md#comp-flow-library) | [log L55][9], [record foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:65][165], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:63][166] |
| <a id="rule-flow-delete-closure"></a><code>rule-flow-delete-closure</code><br/>Business rule | **Deleting a parent deletes its descendants and their edges.** When a parent node is deleted, every descendant is deleted with it, and so is every edge that ends on any of them. The library reports the full set to the application and the live region. **When** A selection that includes a parent node is deleted. **Then** Remove the parent, all descendants and every edge attached to them, and report all of it. | decided | serves: [Carry tsukuri studio's story graph](goals.md#goal-flow-studio-story-graph); triggers: [Delete the selection](business-processes.md#process-flow-delete-selection) | [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/update.ts:289-343][167], [foldkit-flow:README.md:75][168], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:135][169], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-child-clamp"></a><code>rule-flow-child-clamp</code><br/>Business rule | **A clamped child stays inside its parent.** A child node positions relative to its parent. If it is clamped to the parent, a drag or key move cannot take it outside. **If** A child node is clamped to its parent. **Then** Limit its position to the parent's bounds. | decided | serves: [Carry tsukuri studio's story graph](goals.md#goal-flow-studio-story-graph); triggers: [Drag a node](business-processes.md#process-flow-drag-node) | [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/geometry.ts:88][170], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/geometry.ts:451-474][171], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/update.ts:369-385][172], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:89][173], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-keyboard-actions"></a><code>rule-flow-keyboard-actions</code><br/>Business rule | **Keys select, move, delete and clear.** On a focused node, Enter or Space selects, arrow keys move it by a set step (Shift makes it four times larger), Delete or Backspace removes the selection and Escape clears it. A live region announces the result. **When** A key is pressed on a focused node. **Then** Select, move, delete or clear, and announce the result. | decided | serves: [Keyboard-accessible graph editing](goals.md#goal-flow-keyboard-access); triggers: [Work the graph by keyboard](business-processes.md#process-flow-keyboard-navigate) | [foldkit-flow:README.md:75-77][174], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/update.ts:413-435][175], [log L118][8] |
| <a id="rule-flow-memoised-views"></a><code>rule-flow-memoised-views</code><br/>Business rule | **Pointer moves re-render only what changed.** Node and edge views are keyed and memoised with simple arguments. | <a id="rule-flow-invalid-connection-refused"></a><code>rule-flow-invalid-connection-refused</code><br/>Business rule | **A connection the app refuses makes no edge.** The application supplies a validation function. When a connection fails it, no Connected message is sent and no edge is added. **When** A person drops a connection on a target. **If** The application's validation function rejects the connection. **Then** Emit nothing and add no edge. *Why proposed:* The application's `isValidConnection` gates the connect gesture: the handle Mount passes it to xyflow (mounts.ts lines 601 to 625), the snapshot carries it (snapshot.ts line 33), and `update` reports `Connected` only when it accepts the connection (update.ts lines 266 to 281). Spec 0001 sets falsifier J3 (line 85).
